flyer.justification: Extremely clear and visually organized flyer draft that strictly adheres to the 6-word title rule and formatting requirements.

linkedin.justification: Follows all LinkedIn format requirements seamlessly, avoiding banned cliches/fillers while providing an engaging insight-focused post.

instagram.justification: Well-crafted Instagram caption with visual cues, solid structure, engaging tone, call to action, and appropriate hashtag count.

summary.justification: Under the 400-word limit and excellently structured into markdown tables/sections, though it introduces the speaker's name which was not present in the transcript or author profile.

newsletter.justification: Conversational and well-formatted email newsletter, but the subject line slightly exceeds the 50-character limit (53 characters).

blog.justification: Comprehensive, highly articulate Markdown blog post that perfectly satisfies all structural and formatting requirements.
